description: Room state read and closing the room at the end of a meeting.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a current participant with role Member.
LiveKit is configured and reports two people in the room.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant.
cases.return: Success with the room view: myRole Member, status Open, available true, participantCount 2, retentionDays from configuration.

preconditions: Meeting Published with mode Online; caller is a current participant.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant.
cases.return: Success with the room view: status NotStarted, participantCount null; the provider is not asked while the room is not open.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a current participant.
LiveKit is configured but the participant count cannot be read.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant.
cases.return: Success with the room view: status Open, participantCount null; the count is a nicety on the waiting screen and never fails the page.
cases.log: Could not count participants of meeting {MeetingId}.

preconditions: Caller cannot read the meeting (stranger, or meeting does not exist).
cases.inputs: meetingId: that meeting; caller: the stranger.

preconditions: Meeting InProgress with mode Online; caller is a current participant.
The access read fails in storage.
cases.inputs: meetingId: the meeting; caller: the participant.
cases.return: ReadFailed; 500 "Không thể tải trạng thái phòng họp. Vui lòng thử lại." (MSG283).
cases.log: Could not read call room access for meeting {MeetingId}.
